initials.description: Fallback text (usually initials) shown when no photo is set.

background.description: CSS background for the initials fallback (a color or gradient). Defaults to a neutral theme fill.

maxBytes.description: Hard cap for the stored image in bytes (decoded). The block re-encodes at stepped quality, then halves the dimension, until the image fits.

maxDimension.description: Photos are center-cropped square and downscaled to at most this many px per side.

disabled.description: Disable picking or removing a photo.

removable.description: Show a remove control when a photo is set.

changeLabel.description: Hover overlay label when a photo is set.

emptyLabel.description: Hover overlay label when no photo is set.
